subject: general
question: NITI Aayog was constituted on ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1st January 2015**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **NITI Aayog **was **formed by a resolution**.
 
• It was **passed by **the **Union Cabinet **on **1st January 2015**.
 
• **By forming the NITI Aayog **the **Planning Commission **Of **India **was **scraped immediately**.
 
• The **full form **of **NITI is National Institution for Transforming India**.
 
 
• It is the **'Think Tank**' of the Government of India
 
 
 
• The **Governing Council **of **NITI **has **Prime Minister Narendra Modi **as its **Chairman **and also has the **Chief Ministers **of **all states **and Lt. **Governors of all union territories**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NITI AAyog**

 
 
• **NITI Aayog **has the **twin mandate **to oversee the **adoption **and **monitoring of the SDGs **in the **country **and **promote competitive and cooperative federalism **among States and UTs.
 
• The task at hand for NITI Aayog is not just to periodically collect data on SDGs but to proactively realise the goals and targets.
